verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Zechariah 2

The measuring man an angel; Jerusalem too small for the multitudes; a short-term fulfilment in God's protection under Ezra and Nehemiah and an ultimate one under the Messiah; "flee from the land of the north" — most exiles stayed in Babylon; Babylon literal and figurative (Rev 18:4–5); "many nations shall be joined to the LORD"
